signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.invalid: The contact number, email or password is not correct. Please try again.
signIn.inactive: This account is not active. Please contact the Municipal Health Office.
signIn.locked_one: Too many tries. Please wait {{count}} second before you try again.
signIn.locked_other: Too many tries. Please wait {{count}} seconds before you try again.

sessionEnded.title: Your session has ended
sessionEnded.body: For your security, you were signed out after {{minutes}} minutes without activity. Sign in again to continue.

sessionWarning.title: Still there?
sessionWarning.body: You will be signed out in about 1 minute because there has been no activity. Stay signed in to keep working.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: For pregnant women. Health workers receive their accounts from the Municipal Health Office.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.contactIntro: Enter the contact number you signed up with. We will send you a code.
forgot.codeIntro: We sent a 6-digit code to your phone. Enter it below.
forgot.sentAgain: We sent you a new code.
forgot.codeWrong: That code is not correct or has expired. Check it or ask for a new one.
forgot.newPasswordIntro: Choose a password that only you know.
forgot.providerTitle: Please contact the Municipal Health Office
forgot.providerBody: Passwords of health worker and midwife accounts are reset by the Municipal Health Office. Contact the office and they will help you sign in again.

changePassword.title: Choose your own password
changePassword.intro: This is your first sign-in. For your security, choose a new password before you continue.

error.identifier: Enter a contact number such as 0917 555 0123, or an email address.
error.fullName: Enter your first and last name.
error.birthdate: Check your birthdate. It must be a date in the past.
error.phone: Enter a mobile number such as 0917 555 0123.
error.barangay: Choose one of the barangays in the list.
error.weak: Your password does not meet all the rules yet.
error.same: Choose a different password from the one you have now.
error.taken: This number already has an account. Try signing in instead.
error.acknowledge: Please tick the box to continue.
